title: With four candidates the NLA still separates inside from outside but never picks 'outside'
caption: Exp 17 (a), parenthesis items re-scored over four states (149 exp 13 selection items; 11 with an open quote or bracket excluded). Left: the NLA's argmax; outside items go to 'inside a quotation' or 'inside a parenthesis'. Four-way top-1 0.41 [0.33, 0.49] (chance 0.25), below the declared 0.50 bar, so the row was ruled a two-candidate artefact. Right: inside-vs-outside AUROC from the two class candidates, 95% bootstrap CI clustered by passage. Caveat: raw argmax under a strong phrase prior; prior-centred, outside items pick 'outside' 34 of 76.
